title: Two-sided reverse-Markov moment-ratio bracket pins F2 to E_r/E_{r-1} growth: the prize is the single law E_r/E_{r-1} <= C*n*log-correction at r ~ log m
wall: W-BGK (the moment-method depth wall, CharSumMomentDeepWall.lean): the lower bracket is nontrivial only for r < beta+1 = the W-anomaly crossover, while the upper optimum sits at r* ~ log q; the two ends provably do NOT meet, and what survives is exactly the all-even-moments GaussianEnergyBound = the Lam-Leung char-p / BGK wall already named in GaussPeriodMomentBound.lean.
evidence: Two exact-arithmetic probes (scripts/probes/_407_conn/C035_energy_ratio_bracket.py exact field-additive E_r and true B^2 at genuine proper-subgroup large primes; C035_bracket_tightness.py the char-0 Gaussian model E_r=(2r-1)!!n^r at prize scale n=2^10..2^30, beta=4.5-5). FIRST, the two in-tree bricks are real and correctly stated: the LOWER companion exists_period_sq_ge_moment_ratio (WorstPeriodMomentRatioLower.lean) gives max_{b!=0}||eta_b||^2 >= (qE_r - n^{2r})/(qE_{r-1} - n^{2(r-1)}) and the UPPER feeder eta_pow_le_of_energyBound (GaussPeriodMomentBound.lean) gives max^2 <= (qE_r)^{1/r}; both are axiom-clean [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], no open input, both use the proven moment identity sum_b||eta_b||^{2r}=q*E_r with E_r=rEnergy(G,r) the FIELD-ADDITIVE energy #{(v,w) in G^r x G^r: sum v = sum w}. The two-sided bracket object is genuine. The HEADLINE claim (refuted on three exact counts): (1) THE CLAIMED LAW 'E_r/E_{r-1} <= C*n*log-correction' IS SELF-CONTRADICTORY AND FALSE. C035's own model 'TRUE max of m sub-Gaussians, E_r=(2r-1)!!n^r' gives E_r/E_{r-1}=(2r-1)*n, which GROWS like r*n and is bounded by NO constant C*n. The exact field-additive E_r/E_{r-1} confirms growth not flatness: n=8 -> ratio/n = 1.0, 2.62, 3.81, 4.64, 5.22 (r=1..5); n=16 -> 1.0, 2.81, 4.39, 5.75, 6.94; n=32 -> 1.0, 2.91, 4.69, 6.40. There is no constant-C ceiling; the ratio tracks ~ (2r-1) (just below the Gaussian value), so 'pin F2 to a single bounded law E_r/E_{r-1}<=C*n' has no fixed point. (2) THE BRACKETS DO NOT MEET AT ONE r, AND THE GAP EXPLODES AT PRIZE SCALE. Best LOWER bound on B^2 is at r=4-5; best UPPER bound is at r~9-10 (toward r*~log q); the bracket gap (upper/lower, B^2 scale) is 25x at n=2^10, 1006x at n=2^20, 32198x at n=2^30. The headline 'the two sides meet at r ~ log m at scale Theta(sqrt(n log m))' is false in the very Gaussian model C035 invokes. (3) THE LOWER BRACKET HAS A HARD CEILING AT r ~ beta+1 (the W-anomaly crossover). The denominator qE_{r-1} - n^{2(r-1)} > 0 requires q E_{r-1} > n^{2(r-1)}, i.e. (with E_{r-1} ~ c n^{r-1}) beta + r - 1 > 2(r-1), i.e. r < beta+1 -- EXACTLY the W-anomaly/char-p depth crossover the connection's own attack_plan cites. The probe shows LOWER(B^2) going NEGATIVE/nan at r=5-6 for every prize-scale row. So the lower bracket can NEVER reach the optimal upper exponent r*~log q; its best output is B^2 >~ (2beta-1)*n, i.e. B >~ sqrt(beta*n) = sqrt(n log_n q) -- the SAME floor already given by the r=2 case exists_period_sq_ge (C006), not a tightening, and an order of magnitude below the upper sqrt(2 n log q). Empirically at n=8,q=4129: best LOWER=41.3 vs true B^2=57.1 (LOWER/B^2=0.72) and LOWER/(n log m)=0.83; at q=32801 LOWER/(n log m)=0.63 -- the lower bracket undershoots both the true period and the prize target.
honest_note: PARTIAL not REFUTED: the two cited Lean theorems (exists_period_sq_ge_moment_ratio lower companion + eta_pow_le_of_energyBound upper feeder) are genuine, correctly stated, axiom-clean, and DO bracket the worst Gauss period -- the two-sided object is real and useful as a framing. What is refuted is the reduction: (i) the proposed 'single bounded law E_r/E_{r-1} <= C*n' does not exist (the ratio is (2r-1)n, unbounded in r, in C035's own Gaussian model and confirmed growing in the exact field-additive energy); (ii) the upper and lower extremizing r are different and the bracket gap blows up at prize scale (25x -> 32000x as n: 2^10 -> 2^30), so the sides do NOT meet at r~log m; (iii) the lower bracket structurally dies at r ~ beta+1 (denominator goes negative), the W-anomaly crossover the connection itself flags, so it cannot reach the optimal r*~log q and caps at the already-known sqrt(n log_n q) floor. The surviving open content is precisely the UPPER feeder at r*~log q, i.e. GaussianEnergyBound E_r(mu_n) <= (2r-1)!! n^r transferred to char-p at r~log q = the Lam-Leung char-p / BGK wall, which CharSumMomentDeepWall.lean already records reaches only B <~ n^{3/4+o(1)} in the prize regime (char-p moments valid only to depth r_max~2 log_n p). The 'reverse-Markov lower companion' adds no new reach: it telescopes the (2r-1)!! prefactor but the telescoped ratio (2r-1)n is itself unbounded, so the cleaner object is not bounded. Probes: C035_energy_ratio_bracket.py uses exact integer E_r (convolution counts over the literal order-n subgroup) and double-precision Gauss periods at six proper-subgroup large primes (q=4129..5931649, beta 4.0-5.0, n=8..32, n<<sqrt q); C035_bracket_tightness.py uses the lgamma double-factorial Gaussian model at prize-scale n up to 2^30. No closure of anything; recommend DISPROOF_LOG one-liner: 'C035 two-sided energy-ratio bracket does NOT pin B: lower bracket dies at r~beta+1 (W-anomaly crossover, den<0), best output = the known sqrt(n log_n q) floor; upper optimum at r*~log q never met (gap 25x->32000x, n 2^10->2^30); the telescoped law E_r/E_{r-1}=(2r-1)n is unbounded so no single C*n law exists; welds to GaussianEnergyBound char-p depth wall (CharSumMomentDeepWall n^{3/4}).'
